question: Why does the infinite-regress objection against consecration fail in this teaching?
premises: Objectors claim consecrating fire requires another fire and so on.
Such reasoning alleges infinite regress in consecration.
This guru teaching removes the basis of that objection.
inference: In the guru's teaching, the infinite-regress objection against consecration is baseless and defeated.
